translations.web: He said to me, ‘Please stand beside me, and kill me; for anguish has taken hold of me, because my life lingers in me.’
translations.bsb: Then he begged me, ‘Stand over me and kill me, for agony has seized me, but my life still lingers.’
translations.kjv: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.
translations.asv: And he said unto me, Stand, I pray thee, beside me, and slay me; for anguish hath taken hold of me, because my life is yet whole in me.
